What is the reliability assessment on overweight or obese youth (12 to 17, self-reported BMI) in Région de Lanaudière, Quebec, 2021/2022 (percent)?
response_text:
**"Use with caution"** — the estimate carries the `E` quality flag.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Estimate | **26.5%** |
| 95% CI | 15.8% – 40.9% |
| Status flag | `E` = "use with caution" |
| Vector | v115551972 (coordinate 36.1.1.8.4) |

All three rows for this indicator (point estimate and both CI bounds) carry `E`. The reason is visible in the data itself: the confidence interval spans 15.8–40.9, a width of ~25 percentage points on a 26.5 estimate — a coefficient of variation high enough that Statistics Canada marks it as usable only with caution, not as a firm figure. Compare the adult obesity row from the same region (33.7%, CI 30.1–37.5), which carries no flag.

Practically: treat 26.5% as an order-of-magnitude indication for Lanaudière youth, don't compare it against other regions or prior cycles without formally testing the difference, and always publish it with the `E` marker attached.
